decks.notes: The main concept of this UWx Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize, Prismatic Ending, and Force of Will, while also generating card advantage and controlling the board with cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck aims to maintain board control through targeted removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and counter magic like Daze and Force of Will, while also presenting threats like Murktide Regent and Barrowgoyf to close out the game. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's game plan and ensure consistency in casting spells.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures, then using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to cheat them into play. This allows for explosive plays and the potential to overwhelm opponents with massive threats early in the game. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of card selection, graveyard manipulation, and powerful creatures, the deck aims to win quickly and decisively.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while also applying pressure with aggressive creatures. By using cards like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will to control the opponent's resources, the deck aims to clear the path for efficient threats like Murktide Regent and Brazen Borrower. Baleful Strix serves as a versatile card draw option and Orcish Bowmasters, along with Kaito, Bane of Nightmares, help to further disrupt the opponent's creatures. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card advantage and utility. The deck's mana base is streamlined for consistency and can also disrupt the opponent with Wasteland.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to establish board control through cards like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending, while also being able to protect its own threats with counterspells like Force of Will. The inclusion of powerful planeswalker cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student further adds to the deck's ability to manipulate the game in its favor.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures and spells, then use powerful graveyard recursion cards like Dread Return and Reanimate to bring back key combo pieces such as Thassa's Oracle and Balustrade Spy to win the game in a single explosive turn. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Pact of Negation and Cabal Therapy to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The abundance of mana accelerants like Dark Ritual and Lotus Petal help to quickly generate the resources needed to execute the combo.

Utilize powerful reanimation spells and discard effects to quickly bring back high-impact creatures like Emrakul, Griselbrand, and Archon of Cruelty from the graveyard to dominate the field. With an emphasis on speed and efficiency, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its ability to cheat creatures into play early and disrupt their plans with targeted discard spells like Thoughtseize and Cabal Therapy. By combining graveyard manipulation with explosive combos, this deck is a force to be reckoned with in Legacy 1 vs 1 matches.

The main concept of this deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with key creatures using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, and then utilizing reanimation spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to bring them back onto the battlefield for powerful combos. The deck also includes disruption elements such as Thoughtseize and Daze to control the opponent's game plan, while featuring threats like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent for aggressive plays. The mana base includes dual lands like Underground Sea and Polluted Delta, along with utility lands like Wasteland and Undercity Sewers to ensure smooth gameplay.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures and use spells like Animate Dead and Reanimate to bring them back onto the battlefield for a powerful and explosive combo. The deck includes cards like Entomb, Brainstorm, and Thoughtseize to set up the graveyard and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a combination of fast mana sources like Daze and powerful disruption spells like Force of Will, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with reanimated threats and control the game with powerful creatures.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's mana base with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void, while also deploying aggressive creatures like Broadside Bombardiers and Pyrogoyf to apply pressure. The deck utilizes powerful red spells like Fury, Sundering Eruption, and Shatterskull Smashing to control the board and finish off the opponent. By leveraging fast mana sources such as Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide, as well as land destruction tools like The One Ring and City of Traitors, this deck aims to overwhelm and outpace the opponent in Legacy 1v1 matches.

The deck focuses on assembling a quick and powerful combo that aims to win the game in a single turn. By utilizing various mana acceleration cards and combo pieces like Boggart Trawler, Balustrade Spy, and Thassa's Oracle, the deck can mill out the opponent's entire deck and win the game by drawing cards with an empty library. The inclusion of disruptive elements like Pact of Negation and Cabal Therapy helps to protect the combo and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck aims to create a game-winning board state in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, and then bringing them back onto the battlefield with Animate Dead. It aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, while also controlling the game with counterspells like Force of Will. The deck also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, the key strategy is to cheat big creatures into play early and use them to win the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly disrupt opponents' mana bases and lock them out of casting spells with cards like Blood Moon, Magus of the Moon, and Chalice of the Void. The deck also aims to apply pressure with aggressive creatures like Pyrogoyf and Broadside Bombardiers. By utilizing fast mana sources like Ancient Tomb and City of Traitors, this deck seeks to establish a dominant board presence early in the game and maintain control by utilizing powerful removal spells like Fury and Sundering Eruption.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck aims to quickly ramp up with powerful land cards like Eldrazi Temple and Eye of Ugin, while using powerful Eldrazi creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Glaring Fleshraker to disrupt the opponent and apply pressure. The deck also features disruptive spells like Chalice of the Void and Kozilek's Command to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. The key strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupt their strategy before they can establish a strong board presence.

The central idea of this deck is to use aggressive creatures, such as Magus of the Moon, to disrupt the opponent's mana base and lock them out of the game with cards like Blood Moon and Chalice of the Void. The deck aims to establish an early board presence and control the game through disruptive spells, while also using powerful dragon-themed cards like Fury and Sundering Eruption to close out the game quickly. The deck relies on fast mana sources like Chrome Mox and Simian Spirit Guide to quickly deploy threats and overwhelm the opponent before they can recover.

This deck aims to overload opponents with powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupt their gameplan with cards like Chalice of the Void and Thought-Knot Seer. It utilizes mana acceleration tools like Grim Monolith and Lotus Petal to quickly deploy threats and pressure the opponent with aggressive plays. The deck also includes land destruction elements with Wasteland to disrupt the opponent's mana base. The goal is to overwhelm opponents with big creatures and keep them on the back foot, while controlling the game with disruptive elements and powerful Eldrazi cards.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive Goblin tribal strategy. The deck utilizes cards like Goblin Lackey and Rundvelt Hordemaster to quickly put multiple creatures onto the battlefield. Aether Vial is used to cheat creatures into play while cards like Mogg War Marshal and Skirk Prospector provide additional value when sacrificing creatures. The deck also includes various utility goblins like Munitions Expert and Muxus, Goblin Grandee to deal with threats and generate card advantage. The goal is to maximize early game pressure and maintain a strong board presence to quickly defeat the opponent.
